---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or improvement for PDM
title: '[Feature] '
labels: enhancement, needs-triage
assignees: ''
---

## Summary

A short, one-line description of the feature.

## Problem It Solves

Describe the problem or limitation you're running into. Why does this matter?

> Example: "I frequently download large datasets and have to manually organize them into folders. It takes 10+ minutes per session."

## Proposed Solution

Describe your ideal solution. Be as specific as you can.

## Alternative Approaches

Have you considered other ways to solve this? What are the trade-offs?

## Additional Context

- Screenshots, mockups, or diagrams are very welcome
- Links to how other tools handle this
- Relevant use cases

## Who Would Benefit

- [ ] Individual users (casual downloaders)
- [ ] Power users (large volume, automation)
- [ ] Researchers / students (large files, datasets)
- [ ] Enterprise / IT administrators
- [ ] Developers (integrating PDM via CLI or API)

## Implementation Notes (optional)

If you have thoughts on how this could be implemented technically, share them here. Not required — just helpful context for contributors.
